did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A MPO's Napa with a 10+2 bonus was on the market. Wholesale buyer Rahim Traders ordered 10 boxes. The owner put the goods into stock at the discount paid (12%), received the order, and opened the memo.

checks.text: The buyer is offered the bonus: "Take 10, get 2 free"; the pre-order is for 10 boxes at the offer price (275)
On the received order the bonus is its own line: 10 boxes at 275.00 and 2 boxes at 0.00, so the bonus has no price but still leaves stock
The memo shows it separately: "Napa (Bonus) 500 mg, 2 Box × 0.00" under the paid line, and the total is for the 10 boxes only (2,750.00)

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

shots.caption: The owner: the MPO goods are in stock, ready to receive
The received order: 10 boxes, and 2 bonus boxes at 0.00
The memo: the bonus on its own line
